$comment: Independent review configuration review_config 1.0.0 (docs/dev/independent-review-spec.md section 5.1), kept at <project>/reviews/review-config.json. Allowed ranges, the loose direction of each quality threshold (weak_config) and the private_dir placement are Python rules in contracts/review.py (CONFIG_RULES, config_problems, weak_config); an out-of-range value is config_out_of_range. lens_models and filter are optional fields added in contracts 3.4.0, expert in contracts 3.6.0; a configuration without them is read exactly as before.

models.description: models assigned to slots in rotation

refutation_min_attempts_for_ratio.description: 3-10; provisional; higher is looser; effective threshold min(this, deep units), minimum 3

extra_lenses.description: lenses added to the fixed four; never removes one

private_dir.description: outside the project tree and the host's shared directories; default $XDG_STATE_HOME/hep-research/reviews/ or ~/.local/state/hep-research/reviews/

lens_models.description: contracts 3.4.0, optional: lens name -> the model of that lens's lens slot in every round (its shadow keeps the rotation and differs from it when models has another); each model must be in models (config_out_of_range otherwise)

filter.description: contracts 3.4.0, optional: a filtering pass over the accepted round-1 findings (spec 6.9), run by one agent of this model; absent, there is no filtering pass

model.description: the model of the filter slot

expert.description: contracts 3.6.0, optional: an expert slot in round 1 (spec 6.10), one agent of this model that reads the whole document and reports only substantive physics, statistics or method errors; absent, there is no expert slot

model.description: the model of the expert slot
